annotations.title: One site: its last 7 days (as in the weekly brief), open incidents, domain and TLS expiry

description: Wraps GET /api/sites/{slug}. One site: its last 7 days (as in the weekly brief), open incidents, domain and TLS expiry. Call this to answer questions about one site: how it did this week, what's wrong with it now, and when its domain or certificate runs out.
name: sites_by_slug

checkFrom.description: where the homepage, nav and newest-content checks run; a failure is checked again from the other location before it alerts or counts against uptime

expiresAt.description: when its registration ends (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

domain.description: its domain's registration, from RDAP; null when not looked up

items.description: A problem the monitor found, open or resolved

cause.description: what the check saw, in our fixed words (never the site's text)

details.description: the kind's own facts: counts, before and after values, the page (`page`), how it ended (`resolution`)

dismissed.description: the team marked it as noise: still open, never alerts again

domain.description: the domain, for domain incidents (expiry, DNS, the registrar's flags)

id.description: the incident's id, for /api/incidents/{id} and its writes

kind.description: what kind of problem: site_down, slow, page_broken, broken_links, … (label says it in words)

label.description: the kind in words, as the dashboard says it

clues.description: what points there: errors, other sites, where it was seen, pushes and changes just before

likely.description: the likely cause in a sentence; null when the rules found none

missing.description: why there's none: its checks were purged (they're kept RETENTION_DAYS) before a diagnosis was saved

likelyCause.description: outages, slowdowns and broken pages only: the monitor's rules, as in the alert; a resolved one's as saved when it ended

resolvedAt.description: when it ended (ISO 8601, UTC); null while it's open

severity.description: down: an outage, alerted at once; warning: something to fix

site.description: the site's slug; null for a domain's or project's incident

url.description: the page or file it's about; null when it's about the whole site or a domain

public.description: it has a public status page

slug.description: the site's slug: its id in every /api/sites/{slug} route

status.description: its status now: "up", "down", "degraded" (up, with warnings open) or "unknown" (not checked yet)

expiresAt.description: when the certificate ends (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

dismissed.description: of the week's incidents, how many the team dismissed

htmlBytes.description: the homepage's weight, week over week

now.description: the homepage's HTML today, bytes unpacked

longestOutageMs.description: the longest of them, ms; null with none

missing.description: why a section is null: traffic; empty when nothing is missing

traffic.description: set when traffic is null: no Cloudflare traffic: the team hasn't connected Cloudflare for this site, or its first hours aren't in yet

outages.description: outages that began in the week

pageErrors.description: new errors from the site's own code right now

inpP75.description: Interaction to Next Paint, 75th percentile, ms (good ≤ 200)

periodEnd.description: the last day of Chrome's 28-day window (YYYY-MM-DD)

stale.description: the window ended more than 45 days ago: Chrome stopped reporting the site, and these numbers describe it as it was then

ttfbP75.description: time to first byte, 75th percentile, ms (good ≤ 800)

readers.description: Real readers on phones (Chrome UX Report, 28 days); null when Chrome has too little data. Times in ms

cacheHits.description: requests Cloudflare answered from its cache

visits.description: requests Cloudflare served in the week: every request, crawlers and agents included (Cloudflare's Free plan doesn't separate them)

weekBefore.description: the same for the week before; null without a full week

traffic.description: from the team's Cloudflare connection; null without one (missing.traffic says why)

typicalMs.description: median homepage response time (time to first byte); for a site checked from both locations, of their average, each location counted once

uptime.description: Checks that passed, of those made, in a period

percent.description: ok / total × 100, two decimals; null with no checks

warnings.description: warnings that began in the week

week.description: the last 7 days, as in the weekly brief; null for paused sites

next_steps.description: calls that usually come next, each naming its tool

tool.description: the tool that makes this call
